sloka: ततः सुषेण प्रमुखाः प्लवंगमाःसुग्रीव वाक्यम् निपुणम् निशम्य ।आमंत्र्य सर्वे प्लवगाधिपम् तेजग्मुर् दिशम् ताम् वरुण अभिगुप्ताम् ॥४-४२-५८॥
transliteration: tataḥ suṣeṇa pramukhāḥ plavaṁgamāḥsugrīva vākyam nipuṇam niśamya ।āmaṁtrya sarve plavagādhipam tejagmur diśam tām varuṇa abhiguptām ॥4-42-58॥

translations.english: Then all those monkeys headed by Sushena, having heard the shrewd word of Sugriva, took leave of the lord of monkeys and went to that quarter which is guarded by Varuna.
